_comment: Repository-specific policy. Merged onto neotree/security-ci policy.defaults.json.
This file may TIGHTEN the gate but never loosen it: removing a blocking severity is
rejected and reported as POLICY_OVERLAY_WEAKENED. Everything here is a security
control, so changes require Code Owner review and a security-reviewed:<sha7> label.

exceptions.reason: ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN migrations. The column name and type come from fixed arrays in the source (SESSIONS_ADDED_COLUMNS in schema.ts, newExceptionColumns in db.ts); SQLite cannot bind identifiers, and no runtime or user data reaches these statements.

Interpolates WHERE fragments built in code by pendingSessionFilter() and QUARANTINED_SESSION_FILTER (exportPlanning.ts). Column names in those fragments are literals and every value - countries, hospital, dates, batch size - is a bound ? parameter.

Sessions paging and UID search compose fixed SQL fragments (SESSIONS_FOR_LOCATION_WHERE, cursor and match clauses) chosen in code. All user input - search term, cursor, location, limit - is passed as bound ? parameters.

Column names cannot be bound, so every key is checked against the sessions schema (assertSessionColumns) before the SQL is built; values are bound ? parameters. An unknown or crafted key is rejected before reaching SQL.
